title: Bach through organ and orchestra
work: Toccata and Fugue in D minor, BWV 565 — opening
question: What do orchestral colours add to the opening gestures of an organ work?
intro: Stokowski’s orchestral transcription and its first recording date from 1927; Norbert Schenk’s organ recording was made in Solms-Albshausen in 2017. Here the opening carried on Stokowski’s first disc side is aligned with the organ performance, not with the entire later fugue. The full organ recording remains playable, while the 78-rpm sides are not concatenated.

recordings.label: Stokowski, 1927 · side 1
recordings.note: Compare the orchestral expansion and withdrawal around the opening gestures; this is not the later Fantasia soundtrack.

recordings.label: Schenk, 2017
recordings.note: Hear the same outline sustained on the church organ; the recording continues beyond the aligned opening.
